title: How to play
summary: Story stage EX-5 EVENT; challenge mode opens once it is cleared.

sections.title: Rules
items: Score as high as you can
Tap the left or right side (A / D) to jump to that rope
2 — an obstacle costs one, then 2 s of safety
160 (the table doesn’t say what earns them)
Obstacles move at 6 × the step’s speed multiplier; the first one comes 20 units in

sections.title: Difficulty over time
sections.note: The step rises every 5 s. After the last step the speed keeps rising by 0.05 every 5 s. Gap is the distance between obstacles. Pattern shows the weights of the table’s “line 1” and “line 2” spawn patterns (likely one rope blocked or both; meaning unclear).

pages.title: Climb, Soda! - Story Mode
pages.text:
■ This is a game where you dodge obstacles and climb the ropes.
■ Tap the left side of the screen to jump to the rope on the left. (Shortcut key: A)
■ Tap the right side of the screen to jump to the rope on the right. (Shortcut key: D)
■ Your HP will decrease if you bump into the obstacles.
■ In the story mode, survive until the target time to clear the stage.

pages.title: Climb, Soda! - Challenge Mode
pages.text:
■ This is a game where you dodge obstacles and climb the ropes.
■ Tap the left side of the screen to jump to the rope on the left. (Shortcut key: A)
■ Tap the right side of the screen to jump to the rope on the right. (Shortcut key: D)
■ Your HP will decrease if you bump into the obstacles.
■ In the challenge mode, your goal is to get the highest score possible.
